recipe.visualDefinition: A complex surrealist scene contained within a dark circular porthole, featuring a central classical statue throwing a disc, flanked by a ballerina on a checkered bed and cats peering through foliage, all unified by a spiral of kinetic typography.
coreVisualRelationships: Circular frame acting as a window into a disparate dreamscape
Spiral typographic path creating a sense of centrifugal motion
Juxtaposition of classical sculpture and performing arts within a pastoral setting
Contrast between the dark, textured outer square and the bright, saturated inner circle
coreInvariants: Presence of a classical male athlete and a female dancer
Muted, painterly texture with visible brushwork

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The Discobolus statue is the central anchor, slightly left of center; the ballerina is scaled smaller on the right; cats occupy the lower left foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central blue-toned statue and the bright yellow path leading to the horizon.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the spiral of text from the top center, curving down the left side and inward toward the center, mimicking the rotation of a record.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The dark blue textured square provides heavy negative space that pushes the viewer's focus into the central 'lens'.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy blue (outer frame and shadows)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Golden yellow and earthy ochre (path and frame border)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale sky blue and lavender (statue and bed linens)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation within the circle contrasted against the low-value, dark matte finish of the surrounding square.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Bold, rounded sans-serif with high-contrast outlines
letterConstructionRules: Thick dark outlines to separate letters from the background
Variable color fills following a gradient or sequence
Perspective distortion to follow a circular arc
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are warped to fit a spiral path
Inner counters are tight and circular

composition.scale: Large at top, tapering slightly as it spirals inward

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface used with varying colors and orientations to create rhythmic complexity.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: Pump Triline or similar heavy rounded display

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight for the spiral warping.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a surrealist oil painting inside a circular frame. The scene includes a blue classical statue of a disc thrower in the center, a ballerina in a white tutu standing on a pink checkered bed to the right, and two cats peeking through green leaves on the left. The background is a sunny landscape with a yellow path. The circle is surrounded by a dark navy blue textured square with a thin gold border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply bold, rounded uppercase sans-serif text in a spiral path starting from the top center and curving down the left side. Use heavy dark outlines. The text color should transition from gold at the top to blue on the left and white at the bottom.

verificationChecks: Text follows a clear spiral path
Statue and ballerina are both present
Circular frame is centered in a dark square
Colors transition across the text elements

adjustableVariables: Specific colors of the text spiral
Scale of the ballerina relative to the statue
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the figures to avoid likeness issues
Any unique brand logos or specific signatures
Exact letterforms if they match a proprietary brand font
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not obscure the faces of the main subjects
Check that the gold border is thin and consistent
Verify the checkered pattern on the bed is visible
Confirm the dark blue outer area has a subtle canvas-like texture
recipe.reuseFormula: Surrealist collage + circular porthole frame + spiral kinetic typography + classical vs. modern subject juxtaposition.
